facts: Opium-producing region of Afghanistan, Iran and Pakistan.

places.name: Congo Basin
facts: The second-largest tropical rainforest.

places.name: Greenland
facts: The world’s largest island, mostly under an ice sheet.

places.name: New Guinea
facts: The world’s second-largest island, shared by Indonesia and Papua New Guinea.

places.name: Borneo
facts: The only island shared by three countries.

places.name: Madagascar
facts: The fourth-largest island; lemurs and baobabs found nowhere else.

places.name: Sumatra
facts: The 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake struck off its north-west coast.

places.name: Honshu
facts: Japan’s largest island, with Tokyo and Mount Fuji.

places.name: Great Britain
facts: The largest island of Europe.

places.name: Sri Lanka
facts: Separated from India by the Palk Strait and the Gulf of Mannar.

places.name: Iceland
facts: Sits on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge over a hotspot; geysers and geothermal power.

places.name: Hawaii
facts: Volcanic islands formed over a mid-Pacific hotspot.

places.name: Galápagos Islands
facts: Their wildlife inspired Darwin’s theory of evolution.

places.name: Maldives
facts: The world’s lowest-lying country, of coral atolls, threatened by sea-level rise.

places.name: Mauritius
facts: Volcanic island with a large population of Indian origin.

places.name: Diego Garcia
facts: Atoll of the Chagos archipelago hosting a US–UK base; the UK agreed in 2024–25 to return sovereignty of the Chagos to Mauritius.

places.name: Socotra
facts: Island of Yemen with the dragon’s blood tree.

places.name: Svalbard
facts: Arctic archipelago with the Global Seed Vault and India’s Himadri research station.

places.name: Tasmania
facts: Island state south of mainland Australia.

places.name: Cape of Good Hope
facts: Rounded by Vasco da Gama in 1497 on the way to India.

places.name: Cape Agulhas
facts: The southernmost point of Africa, where the Atlantic and Indian Oceans officially meet.

places.name: Cape Horn
facts: Southern tip of South America, notorious for storms.

places.name: Cape Verde
facts: The westernmost point of mainland Africa, at Dakar.

places.name: Cabo da Roca
facts: The westernmost point of mainland Europe.

places.name: Cape York
facts: The northernmost point of mainland Australia.

places.name: Angel Falls
facts: The world’s highest uninterrupted waterfall (979 m), off a tepui.

places.name: Victoria Falls
facts: The largest curtain of falling water, on the Zambezi.

places.name: Niagara Falls
facts: Between Lakes Erie and Ontario on the US–Canada border.

places.name: Iguazu Falls
facts: A system of about 275 falls on the Argentina–Brazil border.

places.name: Washington, D.C.
facts: Capital of the United States on the Potomac.

places.name: Ottawa
facts: Capital of Canada.

places.name: Mexico City
facts: Built on a drained lake bed at about 2,240 m.

places.name: Brasília
facts: Planned capital of Brazil since 1960.

places.name: Buenos Aires
facts: Capital of Argentina on the Río de la Plata.

places.name: Lima
facts: Coastal desert capital of Peru.

places.name: Bogotá
facts: High Andean capital of Colombia.

places.name: Santiago
facts: Capital of Chile in the central valley.

places.name: London
facts: On the Thames; Greenwich marks the Prime Meridian.

places.name: Paris
facts: On the Seine; the Paris climate agreement (2015).

places.name: Berlin
facts: Capital of Germany on the Spree.

places.name: Moscow
facts: Capital of Russia on the Moskva.

places.name: Rome
facts: On the Tiber; encloses Vatican City.

places.name: Madrid
facts: On the Meseta plateau at the centre of Spain.

places.name: Kyiv
facts: On the Dnipro.

places.name: Ankara
facts: Capital of Türkiye on the Anatolian plateau.

places.name: Cairo
facts: At the head of the Nile delta; the Giza pyramids are nearby.

places.name: Addis Ababa
facts: Headquarters of the African Union.

places.name: Nairobi
facts: Headquarters of UNEP.

places.name: Abuja
facts: Planned capital of Nigeria since 1991.

places.name: Pretoria
facts: Executive capital of South Africa (Cape Town legislative, Bloemfontein judicial).

places.name: Kinshasa
facts: On the Congo, facing Brazzaville across the river.

places.name: Riyadh
facts: Capital of Saudi Arabia in the Najd.

places.name: Tehran
facts: At the foot of the Alborz mountains.

places.name: Baghdad
facts: On the Tigris.

places.name: Astana
facts: Steppe capital of Kazakhstan since 1997.

places.name: Beijing
facts: Capital of China at the northern edge of the North China Plain.

places.name: Tokyo
facts: On Honshu; the world’s largest metropolitan area.

places.name: Seoul
facts: On the Han river.

places.name: Bangkok
facts: On the Chao Phraya delta.

places.name: Hanoi
facts: On the Red River delta.

places.name: Jakarta
facts: Sinking coastal capital on Java; Nusantara on Borneo is being built as its successor.

places.name: Kuala Lumpur
facts: Capital of Malaysia; Putrajaya is the administrative centre.

places.name: Singapore
facts: City-state at the southern end of the Strait of Malacca; one of the busiest ports.

places.name: Manila
facts: On Manila Bay, Luzon.

places.name: Canberra
facts: Planned capital of Australia, chosen as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne.

places.name: Wellington
facts: On Cook Strait; the world’s southernmost national capital.

places.name: New Delhi
facts: Capital of India.

places.name: New York
facts: Headquarters of the United Nations.

places.name: Geneva
facts: Hosts the WHO, WTO, ILO and the UN Human Rights Council.

places.name: Chabahar
facts: Iranian port developed with India (Shahid Beheshti terminal), giving access to Afghanistan and Central Asia.

places.name: Bandar Abbas
facts: Iranian port on the Strait of Hormuz; a node of the International North–South Transport Corridor.

places.name: Duqm
facts: Omani port where the Indian Navy has access.

places.name: Sabang
facts: Indonesian port at the northern mouth of the Malacca Strait; India is helping develop it.

places.name: Rotterdam
facts: Europe’s largest port, at the mouth of the Rhine.

places.name: Shanghai
facts: The world’s busiest container port, at the mouth of the Yangtze.

states.name: Arunachal Pradesh
states.fact: Largest state of the Northeast; borders Bhutan, China and Myanmar.

states.name: Assam
states.fact: Brahmaputra and Barak valleys; home to Kaziranga and Manas.

states.name: Chandigarh
states.fact: Planned city by Le Corbusier; capital of both Punjab and Haryana.

states.name: Karnataka
states.fact: Western Ghats and Deccan plateau; Kaveri rises at Talakaveri.

states.name: Manipur
states.fact: Loktak lake with floating phumdis and Keibul Lamjao, the only floating national park.

states.name: Meghalaya
states.fact: Garo, Khasi and Jaintia hills; Mawsynram and Cherrapunji are among the wettest places.

states.name: Mizoram
states.fact: Lushai hills; borders Myanmar and Bangladesh.

states.name: Nagaland
states.fact: Naga hills; Saramati is its highest peak.

states.name: Punjab
states.fact: Land of five rivers; Sutlej, Beas and Ravi flow through it.

states.name: Rajasthan
states.fact: Largest state by area; the Aravalli range divides the Thar desert from the east.

states.name: Sikkim
states.fact: Eastern Himalaya; Kangchenjunga and the Nathu La pass to Tibet.

states.name: Tripura
states.fact: Surrounded by Bangladesh on three sides.

states.name: Uttarakhand
states.fact: Formed in 2000 from Uttar Pradesh; source of the Ganga and Yamuna.

states.name: Telangana
states.fact: Formed in 2014 from Andhra Pradesh; on the Deccan plateau.

states.name: Bihar
states.fact: Middle Ganga plain; the Kosi is called the “Sorrow of Bihar”.

states.name: Kerala
states.fact: Malabar coast backwaters; Vembanad and Ashtamudi are Ramsar sites.

states.name: Madhya Pradesh
states.fact: Heart of India; Narmada flows west between the Vindhya and Satpura ranges.

states.name: Andaman and Nicobar Islands
states.fact: Separated by the Ten Degree Channel; Barren Island is India’s only active volcano.

states.name: Gujarat
states.fact: Longest coastline of any Indian state; Rann of Kutch and Kathiawar peninsula.

states.name: Lakshadweep
states.fact: Coral atolls in the Arabian Sea; smallest UT by area.

states.name: Odisha
states.fact: Mahanadi delta; Chilika is Asia’s largest brackish-water lagoon.

states.name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
states.fact: Two UTs merged into one in January 2020.

states.name: Jammu and Kashmir
states.fact: Became a Union Territory in 2019; Jhelum flows through the Kashmir valley.

states.name: Chhattisgarh
states.fact: Formed in 2000 from Madhya Pradesh; Mahanadi basin and Bastar plateau.

states.name: Delhi
states.fact: National Capital Territory on the Yamuna.

states.name: Goa
states.fact: Smallest state by area; Mandovi and Zuari estuaries.

states.name: Haryana
states.fact: Formed in 1966 from Punjab; surrounds Delhi on three sides.

states.name: Himachal Pradesh
states.fact: Western Himalaya; Sutlej, Beas, Ravi and Chenab flow through it.

states.name: Jharkhand
states.fact: Formed in 2000 from Bihar; Chota Nagpur plateau, rich in minerals.

states.name: Tamil Nadu
states.fact: Coromandel coast; Kaveri delta and the Nilgiri hills.

states.name: Uttar Pradesh
states.fact: Most populous state; the Ganga–Yamuna doab and the Terai.

states.name: West Bengal
states.fact: From the Darjeeling Himalaya to the Sundarbans delta.

states.name: Andhra Pradesh
states.fact: Longest coastline among the states on the east coast; Godavari and Krishna deltas.

states.name: Puducherry
states.fact: Four enclaves: Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe and Yanam.

states.name: Maharashtra
states.fact: Deccan traps; Godavari, Krishna and Bhima rise in its Western Ghats.

states.name: Ladakh
states.fact: Union Territory since 2019; cold desert between the Karakoram and the Great Himalaya.
